description: Expands chosen analysis windows into sustained spectral holds: the datafile pairs each hold TIME with a hold DURATION, and the process stretches that single window to the given length before continuing, so the output is LONGER than the input by the sum of the hold durations. Verified: holds of 0.8 + 0.5 s on a 2.023 s analysis -> 3.3234 s; on a 1.521 s analysis -> 2.8212 s (rule outdur ~ indur + sum(hold_durations), within one window). Deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: The time-dilating freeze: where focus freeze holds a spectrum in place (same length), hold INSERTS stasis - the piece literally waits inside one harmonic moment, then moves on. Musical staples: fermatas on chosen partial constellations, breath-length suspensions before an attack, or a chain of short holds that turns a phrase into a sequence of pillars. Because each hold is a single window sustained, the held sound is perfectly static (organ-like); pair with blur blur upstream for softer plateaus, or follow with tremolo/envel stages to re-animate the held spans. Time points refer to INPUT time; each hold pushes all later material further out.

holddata.description: Text file of paired values 'time holddur' (seconds), one pair per line, times increasing (write with write_data_file()). Refusals verbatim: unpaired data 'ERROR: Freeze times not paired correctly.'; a time beyond the file 'ERROR: Invalid freeze location : 1722.656282' (NOTE: the offending location is quoted in analysis WINDOWS, not seconds - 5.0 s / 0.0029 s frametime = 1722.66).

examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('hold.txt', '0.9 1.5') - the 0.9 s spectrum sustains for 1.5 s; output ~ input + 1.5 s.
write_data_file('hold2.txt', '0.5 0.8\n1.2 0.5') - verified 2.023 s in -> 3.3234 s out (indur + 1.3 s).

known_issues: Output duration is datafile-dependent (indur + sum of hold durations, verified to within one analysis window): the duration pre-flight skips (expression names the aux param); the disk watchdog bounds the run.
The 'Invalid freeze location' refusal quotes the bad time converted to WINDOWS (frametime units), not the seconds you wrote - divide by ~344.5 to recognise your value at 44.1 kHz/1024-point analyses.
Held spans are perfectly static single windows - expect organ-pedal flatness inside holds.
